bound_note: delta + sum of the calibrated rates + the data readouts at the final layout (25a's physical_bound); reported, not certified: the noise theorem is Stage 27
emulator_comparison: no run recorded for this artifact
emulator_run: no run recorded for this artifact
ff_latency_note: the feed-forward latency is an assumption stated by this certificate, not a property of the device
meaning_physical_translation: physically validated: on an ideal device with the target's gates and coupling map, started from all-|0> on its used qubits, the physical circuit realizes the specification with the certified delta under the final layout; not a statement about noise; not verified on hardware

model_premises.P-ctrl: mid-circuit outcomes are recorded and fed forward exactly and the classical bookkeeping (bits, layouts) is exact; the feed-forward latency L is an assumption used for the timing (PhysGrade) only
model_premises.P-prep: every qubit used, data and ancillae, starts in |0> exactly (phys_start: the all-|0> device state is the embedded logical |0>)

noise.meaning: conditional on the premises P-cal, P-stoch, P-ro, P-idle, the device's success probability is at least 1 - delta_prime (noise_bound); the premises are assumptions about the device, not facts proved here; not verified on hardware

premises.P-cal: the calibration snapshot of hw/targets/fake_washington.json (SHA3-256 98325abf8f5c8e70c497f7bd92ff40748e40962999d574a6a71ef639fd243eed), shipped with qiskit-ibm-runtime and recorded from a real device on a past date; not a live calibration
premises.P-idle: idle qubits suffer no error: only the listed operations act (the step list of the theorem); the idle-exposure diagnostic of Stage 27c is not part of the bound
premises.P-ro: every readout, the mid-circuit measurements included, is with probability at least 1 - r its ideal channel and otherwise arbitrary, with r the calibrated readout error of its qubit
premises.P-stoch: every basis operation on k qubits is, with probability at least 1 - p, its ideal channel and otherwise an arbitrary channel on the whole register, with p = min 1 ((d+1)/d * r), d = 2^k, r its calibrated error (the Pauli reading of a randomized-benchmarking error: 3/2 r one-qubit, 5/4 r two-qubit; virtual rz has r = 0); no p reached the clamp
